title: 第7章 寒潮虾兵第8章 副本实验
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
二狗家很贫困，院子都不是土墙，而是树枝木棍混搭的篱笆圈。
周元扒拉两下找了个接力点，抬脚就翻了进去。
整个院子漆黑一片，没有任何灯光点缀，他靠近院中唯一像样的主屋，小心翼翼的趴到窗边。
“娘我冷。”
“快在温水桶里泡泡，孩儿他爹，别再去龙宫偷宝了，再去几次二狗命都没了。”
“不敢再去了，今儿二狗差点回不来，以后再也不去了。”
“啥？二狗没按俺给的法子拿吗，可不敢冒犯龙宫守卫，俺当家的就是这么没的，二狗可不能再犯浑啊。”
一个年轻的女人声音传来，周元猜测她就是二狗新娶的媳妇翠娘。
“翠娘你告诉俺们家龙宫入口，俺们家都沾了你的福气，哪敢不听你的。
就是人的步子大小不一样，你说只能走三十六步，二狗走了三十二步就引起了龙宫守卫的注意。
幸好他跑得快、不贪心，不然非得被戳个窟窿不可。”
“哎，也怪石头那小子不开窍，他要是进了咱们家，就能替二狗下水了。
这村里咱们就能信石头，他独门独户的只要留了后，咱两家就能变一家。”
“爹，说那些干啥，怪害臊的。
不过您说得对，我就信咱家，要是进了别人家，我可不敢说龙宫的事儿。
我怕他们为了那些珠子，把我给活埋了。”
“翠娘给我搭把手，再给二狗续点热水，给他烫透咯。”
“诶，来了···”
周元在屋外听的一愣一愣的，二狗一家没发烧吧。
石拱桥下的清沙河竟然有龙宫，二狗还能从龙宫偷东西？

“呼呼···，终于活过来了。
那龙宫真不是人待的地方，里面冷的刺骨，去一次就能要人半条命。”
“爹娘、媳妇，咱们拿了二十几枚珠子，也算有钱了，可见不得光。
我要是服兵役回来，咱们就说是我的战利品。
我要是回不来，石头哥回来了，你们就说是我的遗物。”
“呸，乱讲什么话，一准能回来。
等你回来，咱们就搬到城里去，好好过日子。”
“不成啊爹，我们要是都走了，谁定期做记号啊。
要是下场暴雨改了河道，后人想找龙宫入口都找不到。”
“是这个理儿，得给后辈留条路，等你回来带翠娘进城，我跟你娘留下。”
又等了一会儿，耳边全是一家人对美好生活的向往，周元才蹑手蹑脚离开了二狗家的院子。
“小看二狗了，没想到这家子人也有点算计。
我还以为二狗真心和我分享一切，原来是看上我这无依无靠、好拉拢的家世了。”
“这翠娘也是个聪明人，也就二狗家没得选。
但凡落到兄弟多的人家，为了那所谓的龙宫，人家还真有可能弄死她。”
周元不知道那所谓的龙宫是真是假，但清沙河中一定有什么产出珠子、危险性又可控的地方，才能让二狗一家得到实惠。
他迎着月色，很快来到了石拱桥下。
content_en:
Ergou's family is very poor. The yard is not a mud wall, but a fence made of branches and sticks.
Zhou Yuan tugged twice to find a relay point, raised his feet and rolled in.
The entire courtyard was pitch black without any lights. He approached the only decent main house in the courtyard and carefully lay down by the window.
"Mom, I'm cold."
"Quickly soak it in a bucket of warm water. Dad, don't go to the Dragon Palace to steal treasures again. If you go there a few more times, your life will be dead."
"I don't dare to go again. Ergou almost couldn't come back today. I will never go back again."
"What? Didn't Ergou get it according to the method I gave you? You don't dare to offend the dragon palace guards. I'm the boss of this family. Ergou can't do anything stupid again."
A young woman's voice came, and Zhou Yuan guessed that she was Ergou's newly married daughter-in-law, Cuiniang.
"Cui Niang, please tell our family the entrance to the Dragon Palace. Our family has been blessed by you, so how dare we disobey you.
It's just that people's steps are different in size. You said they can only take thirty-six steps, but the two dogs took thirty-two steps and attracted the attention of the Dragon Palace guards.
Fortunately, he was fast and not greedy, otherwise he would have been poked in the hole. "
"Hey, it's no wonder that boy Shitou is not enlightened. If he enters our house, he can go into the water for Ergou.
We can trust Shitou in this village. As long as his single-family family stays, our two families can become one family. "
"Dad, what are you talking about? You're so embarrassed.
But you are right, I trust our family. If I enter someone else's house, I would not dare to talk about Dragon Palace.
I was afraid that they would bury me alive for those beads. "
"Cui Niang, give me a hand and add some hot water to Ergou to boil him thoroughly."
"Hey, here we come..."
Zhou Yuan was stunned for a moment while listening outside the house. Ergou and his family didn't have a fever.
There is a Dragon Palace in the Qingsha River under the stone arch bridge. Can the two dogs steal things from the Dragon Palace?
"Huhu..., finally alive.
The Dragon Palace is really not a place for people to stay. It's so cold inside that it can kill half of a person's life just once. "
"Father, mother, and daughter-in-law, we have taken more than twenty beads, and we are considered rich. It can be seen that we are not in the spotlight.
If I come back from military service, let’s call it my trophy.
If I can't come back and Brother Shitou comes back, you will say it is my relic. "
“Bah, you’re talking nonsense, you’ll definitely come back.
When you come back, we will move to the city and live a good life. "
"No, Dad, if we all leave, who will mark the place regularly?
If a heavy rain changes the course of the river, future generations will not be able to find the entrance to the Dragon Palace. "
"That's the reason. We have to leave a way for the younger generation. When you come back and take Cui Niang into the city, your mother and I will stay."
After waiting for a while, with the family's longing for a better life filling his ears, Zhou Yuan quietly left the yard of Ergou's house.
"I underestimated Ergou, but I didn't expect that this family member also had some calculations.
I thought Ergou sincerely shared everything with me, but it turned out that he was attracted by my helpless and easy-to-win family background. "
"This Cui Niang is also a smart person, so the Ergou family has no choice.
If she falls into a family with many brothers, they may really kill her for the sake of the so-called Dragon Palace. "
Zhou Yuan didn't know whether the so-called Dragon Palace was true or false, but there must be some place in the Qingsha River that produced beads and was dangerous and controllable, so that the Ergou family could benefit.
Facing the moonlight, he soon arrived under the stone arch bridge.
